svg.title: Home network: devices, ports and addresses
svg.desc: Internet to modem router to Huawei core switch, with the Dell, printer, Proxmox host with pfSense and VMs, a standby pfSense, a Unifi AP and a Pi voice satellite, showing ports, VLANs and addresses. Solid is working now, dashed is planned.
svg.text: Solid outline: working now. Dashed outline: planned or not moved yet.
